summary: legal checked in 9 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics, while current public terms do not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Compliance disposition: ordinary reversible growth is conditional and is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where required evidence is missing. Technical compliance is not legal certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown.

Analytics and revenue evidence do not support unsupported claims. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; do not treat unavailable data as zero. Amazon evidence is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under an aggregate row that cannot be assigned to a site. Margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and causal lift remain unknown.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or new queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated readiness packets covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence by the existing deadline.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and all 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Progress consists of official source review, partial repository/configuration flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle, then route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, and limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. The stated purpose and processing are understandable, but data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; do not expand alerts.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics is evidence_needed, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. Measurement-only use is conditionally acceptable if consent-gated as described. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking, remarketing, or advertising.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Operational use is conditionally supportable, but log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, subpoena handling, and data-subject-request procedures are not evidenced. Secondary disclosure and monetization are blocked. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory.
